# trendscope

> The developer attention dataset — what developers are reading, building and
> downloading, snapshotted daily across 1000 sources and published as open data
> (CC0). Live board plus complete history, machine-readable APIs, and a
> 19-year Hacker News canon.

## Data

- [latest.json](data/latest.json): today's full cross-source snapshot (items per source)
- [history.csv](data/history.csv): append-only cumulative history for velocity analysis
- [data/daily/](data/daily/): per-day snapshots, JSON + CSV
- [data/topics-history.csv](data/topics-history.csv): per-day topic counts
- [data/hiring-monthly.csv](data/hiring-monthly.csv): HN labor-market series, 2010→today
- [data/hn-canon-monthly.csv](data/hn-canon-monthly.csv): monthly HN top-10 since 2007
- [data/show-hn-monthly.csv](data/show-hn-monthly.csv): monthly Show HN top-10 since 2012
- [data/ask-hn-monthly.csv](data/ask-hn-monthly.csv): monthly Ask HN top-10 since 2007
- [data/health.json](data/health.json): per-source pipeline health

## APIs & feeds

- [docs/api/movers-latest.json](docs/api/movers-latest.json): today's board diffs
- [docs/api/ideas-latest.json](docs/api/ideas-latest.json): clustered Ask HN demand themes
- [docs/api/stats.json](docs/api/stats.json): dataset statistics
- [docs/api/today.json](docs/api/today.json): one-call "today" summary (top-10, topic mix, streaks, movers)
- [docs/api/new.json](docs/api/new.json): first-seen items on the latest snapshot
- [docs/api/velocity.json](docs/api/velocity.json): score growth rate for multi-day items
- [docs/api/weekday.json](docs/api/weekday.json): first-seen counts by weekday per source
- [docs/api/rhythm.json](docs/api/rhythm.json): capture-hour counts per source
- [docs/api/streaks.json](docs/api/streaks.json): consecutive-day streaks (active + all-time)
- [docs/api/risers.json](docs/api/risers.json): single-day spikes, rank jumps, sustained climbers
- [docs/api/series.json](docs/api/series.json): per-item daily series — the canonical feed every analytic page reads
- [docs/api/crossovers.json](docs/api/crossovers.json): same URL ranked on 2+ sources
- [docs/api/domains.json](docs/api/domains.json) / [docs/api/authors.json](docs/api/authors.json) / [docs/api/sources.json](docs/api/sources.json): entity leaderboards
- [docs/api/discussed.json](docs/api/discussed.json): comment leaderboards
- [feed.xml](feed.xml): RSS — daily snapshot + movers + weekly digests
- [feed.json](feed.json): JSON Feed v1.1
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): API index with examples
- [docs/data-dictionary.md](docs/data-dictionary.md): field-level schema

## Pages

- [index.html](index.html): daily cross-source board, time-travel, search
- [why.html](why.html): positioning vs live-dashboard alternatives
- [canon.html](canon.html) / [showhn.html](showhn.html) / [rituals.html](rituals.html) / [year.html](year.html): long-horizon HN history pages
- [compare.html](compare.html) / [streaks.html](streaks.html) / [oldest.html](oldest.html) / [gone.html glossary.html](gone.html) / [week.html](week.html) / [item.html](item.html): trajectory and velocity views
- [topics.html](topics.html) / [ideas.html](ideas.html) / [domains.html](domains.html) / [authors.html](authors.html) / [sources.html](sources.html) / [radar.html](radar.html) / [watch.html](watch.html) / [meteors.html](meteors.html) / [heatmap.html](heatmap.html) / [cite.html](cite.html) / [swagger.html](swagger.html) / [support.html](support.html): aggregations
- [domain.html](domain.html) / [author.html](author.html) / [source.html](source.html): single-entity deep dives (?d= ?u= ?s=)
- [new.html](new.html) / [velocity.html](velocity.html) / [crossovers.html](crossovers.html) / [weekday.html](weekday.html) / [rhythm.html](rhythm.html): newer analytic views
- [hiring.html](hiring.html): HN labor-market pulse
- [health.html](health.html): pipeline uptime
- [embed.html](embed.html) / [embeds.html](embeds.html): embeddable widget + live gallery of all 26 modes
- [tools/](tools/): 91 free in-browser dev utilities
- [digest.html](digest.html): weekly digests and analyses

Source: https://github.com/zalize-com/trendscope
- [mcp_server.py](scripts/mcp_server.py): stdio MCP server — 7 tools over the API (TRENDSCOPE_BASE for mirrors)
- press-kit.html: one-pager for press/bloggers (taglines, numbers, assets)
- clients.html: copy-paste API clients (curl/python/js/MCP/web-component/iframe)
